name.Description: The name of the Config resource. Example: "projects/my-awesome-project/config"

sign_in.Description: Configuration related to local sign in methods.

allow_duplicate_emails.Description: Whether to allow more than one account to have the same email.

anonymous.Description: Configuration options related to authenticating an anonymous user.

enabled.Description: Whether anonymous user auth is enabled for the project or not.

email.Description: Configuration options related to authenticating a user by their email address.

enabled.Description: Whether email auth is enabled for the project or not.

password_required.Description:
Whether a password is required for email auth or not. If true, both an email and
password must be provided to sign in. If false, a user may sign in via either
email/password or email link.

algorithm.Description: Different password hash algorithms used in Identity Toolkit.

memory_cost.Description: Memory cost for hash calculation. Used by scrypt and other similar password derivation algorithms. See https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc7914 for explanation of field.

rounds.Description: How many rounds for hash calculation. Used by scrypt and other similar password derivation algorithms.

salt_separator.Description: Non-printable character to be inserted between the salt and plain text password in base64.

phone_number.Description: Configuration options related to authenticated a user by their phone number.

enabled.Description: Whether phone number auth is enabled for the project or not.

test_phone_numbers.Description: A map of <test phone number, fake code> that can be used for phone auth testing.
